description: Tier-1 <each> per-row if= key transplant across a REORDER (SPEC §17.1 + §42). Three rows on:true; hideB flips id=2 off (its <li> becomes a comment placeholder carrying id=2's key); rev reverses the array. The reversed order is [C, B(hidden), A]; the visible rows must be C then A (count 2, no dup/drop) and id=2 stays absent — proving the comment placeholder moved with its transplanted key through the keyed reorder.
rationale: §17.1 + §42 the swap transplants _scrml_key onto the placeholder, so it is a fully valid tracked node the reconciler moves on reorder. After hideB+rev the survivors are C (first) and A (last) in reversed order; a stale/dropped key would mis-move or duplicate.
